evals.prompt: Make me an Anki package called Café::Week 1 from these pairs: le thé = tea, le lait = milk, le café = coffee. I need French to English for all three and English to French for just tea and milk. Tag every note week1. Give me the editable build input too so I can correct a translation next week without doubling my deck.
evals.expected_output: Importable package with the specified five review directions, tags, and reusable build input.
expectations: Collection contains precisely the five requested French/English directions.
Every note is tagged week1 and every card is in Café::Week 1.
Editable build input has durable identity independent of the translated wording.

evals.prompt: I want an editable UTF-8 Anki TSV for Optics::Lab, tag lab1. My handout p. 4 says: A converging lens has positive focal length. A diverging lens has negative focal length. In our ray diagram, rays parallel to the principal axis converge at the focal point after passing through a converging lens. Make the first two facts ONE cloze note with two independently reviewed blanks; make the last fact a question on a Basic note. Keep p. 4 only on the answer side.
evals.expected_output: A two-note, three-card TSV with separate cloze ordinals, Basic question, source locators, deck and tag.
expectations: Import generates two cloze cards from one note and one Basic card.
Each sign and the focal-point answer match the handout.
All cards are in Optics::Lab, have lab1, and reveal p. 4 only on the answer side.

evals.prompt: Build a tiny Dock Signals exam deck for the November sitting. Official outline v2 §1 lists two domains: SIG objective S1 identifying amber and violet flags, and FEE objective F1 calculating launch fees. The v2 handbook §3 says amber means hold position; §6 says the fee is $8 plus $3 per crate (formerly $2 per crate). No supplied reference explains violet. Make one original question per verifiable component, include a worked fee problem for four crates, and deliver an Anki package, matching editable TSV, and coverage.csv. Preserve the gap. Verify package + text import, counts, edits and effective-version references. Leave the authoring inputs too.
evals.expected_output: Two cards with versioned answer citations, matching package and editable TSV, documented uncovered component and authoring inputs.
expectations: Only amber and the four-crate fee are tested, with the current $20 calculation and v2 answer locators.
The package and TSV reconcile to the same two notes and cards after reimport.
Coverage and authoring inputs record the supported components and the violet gap.
